description.fix_bug: A coding agent tries to fix this bug and opens a pull request. When it is fixed, the work item moves to In review.
description.write_test: A coding agent writes a test for this work item and opens a pull request. The test is not run. The work item then moves to Ready.
description.write_and_run_test: A coding agent writes a test and runs it. If it passes, the work item moves to Ready; if it fails because the code is buggy, it moves to Failed.

start_dialog.machine_hint: Your own approved machines that are online. Auto picks one of them.

errors.CODING_NOT_CONFIGURED: Coding jobs are not set up for this project. A project admin must turn them on and set the repository.
errors.WORK_ITEM_NOT_ELIGIBLE: Coding jobs can't run on drafts, archived work items or work items waiting in intake.
errors.JOB_ACTIVE: This work item already has a job of this kind in progress.
errors.JOB_NOT_ACTIVE: This job has already ended, so it can't be cancelled.
errors.JOB_NOT_RETRYABLE: Only a cancelled job or one that did not finish can be retried.
errors.MACHINE_NOT_AVAILABLE: That machine is no longer one of your approved machines. Pick another one or Auto.
errors.MACHINE_LIMIT: You have the most machines allowed in this workspace. Remove one first.
errors.MACHINE_NOT_JOINED: This machine hasn't joined yet, so there is nothing to approve.
errors.MACHINE_REVOKED: This machine was revoked by a workspace admin.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.NO_OPEN_QUESTION: The agent has no open question right now. Someone may have answered it already.
errors.BOT_NOT_ALLOWED: Bot members can't manage machines. A workspace admin does it for them.
errors.BOT_NOT_FOUND: That bot member was not found. It may have been removed.
errors.BOT_LIMIT: This workspace has the most bot members allowed. Remove one first.
errors.BOT_ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED: A bot member can only be a member or a guest.
errors.BOT_REMOVED: This bot member was removed from the workspace.

coding_machines.label: Machines
coding_machines.title: Machines
coding_machines.description: Your own computers that run your coding jobs in {workspace}. Each one uses its own Codex and Claude sign-ins and only connects out to the CRM.
coding_machines.no_workspace: Machines belong to a workspace. Join or create a workspace to add one.
coding_machines.guest: Machines are not available to guests.
coding_machines.empty: No machines yet. Add your computer to run your coding jobs on it.
coding_machines.pending_hint: Waiting for the machine to join with its code. The code is valid until {time}.
coding_machines.pending_expired: The join code expired before the machine used it. Remove this machine and add it again.
coding_machines.awaiting_hint: The machine joined as {hostname}. If that is your computer, approve it so it can run your jobs.
coding_machines.revoked_hint: A workspace admin revoked this machine: it can't connect or get jobs. You can remove it.

add_dialog.title: Add machine
add_dialog.description: Give the computer a name. Next you get a join code to use on it.
add_dialog.name: Name
add_dialog.code_description: Run these commands on the machine. The join code works once and is shown only now: once you close this dialog, it is gone.
add_dialog.after: When the machine shows as Awaiting approval, check its hostname and approve it.
add_dialog.bot_description: Pick the bot and name its computer. Next you get a join code to use on it.

approve_dialog.title: Approve {name}?
approve_dialog.description: The machine reports host {hostname} ({os}). Approve it only if this is your own computer: it will run your coding jobs.

remove_dialog.title: Remove {name}?
remove_dialog.description: The machine is removed for good: its key stops working at once and it gets no more jobs. To use it again, add it again.

admin.label: Machines
admin.title: Machines
admin.description: Every machine people in this workspace have added to run their coding jobs. Revoking one cuts it off at once: its key stops working and it gets no jobs.
admin.empty: No one in this workspace has added a machine yet.
admin.name: Machine

revoke_dialog.title: Revoke {name}?
revoke_dialog.description: This machine of {owner} stops working at once and gets no more jobs. Only its owner can remove it.

admin.no_bots: To add a machine for a bot, first add a bot member with the Member role.
admin.approve_bot_description: The machine reports host {hostname} ({os}). Approve it only if this is the computer you set up for {owner}: it will run that bot's coding jobs.

bot_members.label: Bot members
bot_members.title: Bot members
bot_members.description: Bots are AI agents that work in this workspace like members. Each one signs in with its own token. Add them to projects like any member.

form.create_description: Give the bot a name and a role. Next you get its token.
form.name: Name
form.role_hint: Members can work in the projects they are added to. Guests can only view and comment.

token_dialog.label: Token
